scope: Live read-only definitions; no official-source text, headers, objects, DSO or MRI payload republished.

formulas.native_scaled_reference: FP64 scale times FP64-promoted raw Ref voxel, stored back as FP32; residual subtraction occurs in FP32.
formulas.native_SSD: Masked FP32 residual square is accumulated into one FP64 scalar in z-major/y-middle/x-fast order, then divided by count. latest_ssd is updated only by cost evaluation.
formulas.native_scale: Masked FP32 raw Ref times FP32 residual product, serial FP64 accumulation; negate dot product then multiply by (2.0 / FP64 count).
formulas.production_direct_scale: FP32 residual times mask divided by count before FP32 Ref product; FP64 reduction then negate and final factor2.
formulas.production_LM_scale: FP32 residual normalized by sqrt(count), passed through another FP32 mask/sqrt(count) weighting before FP32 Ref product; FP64 reduction. This is a half-gradient until full2 conversion.
formulas.existing_FSL_order_control: FP32 Ref*residual*mask product, PyTorch FP64 reduction, then count division and factor2. Early FP32 normalization has already been removed in this control.
formulas.native_coefficient: Float mask*derivative*residual product; per-coefficient Double 3D spline weight times Float product; serial z/y/x support sum. Parallel implementation divides whole coefficients, preserving each coefficient scan order.
formulas.FNIT_coefficient: Double separable adjoint performs Z then Y then X tensor reductions; final normalizer/regularizer grouping also differs from the native full-gradient expression.

first_differences.between: native scale vs existing late-division control
first_differences.first_possible_location: FP64 sum traversal/reduction layout; final (2/n)*(-sum) vs 2*(-sum/n) grouping
precombined Double 3D spline weight and one support dot product vs separable Double reductions

first_differences.conclusion: Derivative projection cannot explain the remaining scale error in this same-input control.

reference_scan_header.interpretation: Diagonal radiological reference; source-defined native X-fast scan is consistent with forward saved-storage X. Header only, no pixels loaded.

limitations: Definitions identify arithmetic differences; no numeric scalar trial has run.
The scalar-only proposal uses existing current-moving residual, not the prior substituted-moving residual which was not separately checkpointed.
Do not reconstruct native SSD from lambda/150 or native cost by subtracting unverified bending components.
Original implementation compilation and caching may affect instruction order; source inspection alone is not runtime trace.
